items.director: Jacques Rozier, this 1972 episode of the French television program Vive le cinéma! was hosted by actor and frequent Orson Welles collaborator Jeanne Moreau. Over lunch at the Ritz Paris hotel, Moreau speaks with Welles about their respective careers and the director’s experience living in Paris.
